messages:
Sam: Heads up — we just got a manifest from OrionLogistics: container C-448 arrived with the wrong GPU mix. Marketplace reserved SKUs expected A100 x160, manifest shows A100 x96 + T4 x64. This affects Dedicated commitments and our joint press/marketplace window next Tue. :warning:

warehouse-bot: MANIFEST PARSE OK — container=C-448, PO=89012, items:
A100: 96
T4: 64
(expected A100:160)

Maria: ugh. Which customers will see shortfalls if we don't fix this? any active canaries tied to the press release?

Dan: quick lookup — three Dedicated commits booked for next week: AcmeCorp (50 A100), Nimbus (40 A100), LabZero (30 A100). Total short = 34 A100 vs PO. Acme has canary traffic scheduled for Tue (press pilot).

Priya: if Acme's canary fails we should pause the marketplace-facing announcement. We can also present degraded config (quantized models on T4) but that changes perf numbers in the PR. Need comms alignment. :thinking:

Kevin: freight update — we can request a SKU swap from the vendor but ETA is 72h for pickup + 48h transit (so ~5 days earliest). Replacement A100 shipment from partner has an 8-day lead. Not good for Tue.

Alex: technical mitigation options:
- fallback model variant (v2-small) runs OK on T4 for non-critical traffic (latency ~2x).
- short-term autoscale rule: route press canary to A100 pool only (risk: starve other customers).

Dan: ops proposal: reassign 34 A100 from non-press Dedicated pools (rotate from lower-priority test accounts) for 48–72h. Backfill with T4 for those test accounts. That keeps canary on true A100 for press. Need approval from Partnerships and Marketplace billing to avoid invoicing/contract issues.

Maria: I can flag two low-priority dev reserve pools to pull from. Will need Priya to sign off on billing mapping change and Sam to approve partner outreach.

Priya: OK to reassign for 72h with accounting note: we'll mark as "temporary reassign — press support" and reconcile usage. But we must update marketplace UI quotas and the partner portal so no automated provisioning fills the freed slots. Alex please add a sticky label on those nodes so autoscaler doesn't auto-fill.

Alex: noted. I'll add `no-autoscale:press-hold` to the node metadata and a quick guard in the autoscaler. Patch ETA 2h.

Kevin: vendor swap still on option B if any replacements show up faster. I'll open an escalation with OrionOps and ask for a cross-dock swap (we can swap T4 <-> A100 from a different manifest in their yard). ETA only if they confirm by EOD.

Sam: decision summary: (1) temporary reassign 34 A100 from non-critical pools (Maria owns list), (2) Alex implements autoscale guard + fallback route, (3) Priya updates billing/quota flags and partner portal, (4) Kevin pursues vendor swap escalation. We keep press on Tue but add an appendix in the release note about "performance targets subject to hardware availability" if contingency triggers.

Maria: I will DM legal for the wording and ping Acme PMs now to set expectations. Owning the reassign. :raised_hands:

Dan: I'll schedule the reassign and set up monitoring alerts for token latency/cold-starts on the canary — if degradation >20% we auto-rollback and Priya will pause the announcement.

Priya: agreed. I'll craft a two-line contingency banner for the partner press page and hold it in drafts.

warehouse-bot: inventory note appended: container C-448 flagged MISMATCH -> escalation_ticket=ORION-7421

Sam: thanks all. Quick ask — everyone comment with ✅ once your piece is started so I can report to execs. I'll also send a short note to the marketplace partner explaining the mitigation plan and timelines. :eyes:
